description: This Java source file implements the CustomerFacade interface, providing business logic for managing customer data, registration, authentication, address updates, and shopping cart merging in an e-commerce application. It serves as an abstraction layer between controllers and underlying services.

classes.name: CustomerFacadeImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CustomerFacade that provides actual business logic for customer operations, address management, cart merging, and registration in an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getCustomerDataByUserName
methods.description: Fetches customer information based on username and store, converting it into a CustomerEntity.

methods.name: mergeCart
methods.description: Merges the session cart with the customer's existing cart, handling various scenarios of cart assignment and merging.

methods.name: getCustomerByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a Customer object by username within a specific store.

methods.name: checkIfUserExists
methods.description: Checks if a username already exists for a specific store to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: registerCustomer
methods.description: Registers a new customer, persisting their data and returning a CustomerEntity.

methods.name: getCustomerModel
methods.description: Constructs a Customer model from a PersistableCustomer, encoding passwords and assigning default groups.

methods.name: customerEntityPoulator
methods.description: Converts a Customer model to a CustomerEntity for external use.

methods.name: setCustomerModelDefaultProperties
methods.description: Assigns default properties such as username, password, and groups to a new Customer model.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates a customer using Spring Security's AuthenticationManager, setting security context.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves either billing or shipping address for a customer.

methods.name: updateAddress
methods.description: Updates a customer's address with new data, handling country and zone validation.

methods.name: getCustomerById
methods.description: Retrieves customer details as a ReadableCustomer by id for display purposes.

methods.name: populateCustomerModel
methods.description: Populates an existing Customer model with data from PersistableCustomer, saving updates.
